AgentInstance.description:
Platform-managed role execution instance (not the API process instance).

One instance may have many historical native sessions; only one active binding
is valid at a time. Do not overwrite old sessionRef and lose history.
AgentInstance.title: AgentInstance

secretRef.description: Secure reference only; never a copied native long-lived secret.
secretRef.title: Secretref

ApprovalConfirmRequest.description: Manual/native ack when adapter reports confirmation asynchronously.
ApprovalConfirmRequest.title: ApprovalConfirmRequest

forward.description: When true, attempt native forward after recording the user decision.
forward.title: Forward

ApprovalSummary.description:
User decision plus native forward/confirm state.

``approved`` / user decide alone is **not** proof the external agent accepted the grant.
Only ``confirmed`` (with matching native request) is effective for native actions.

nativeConfirmed.description: True only after native confirmation for the same request/attempt.
nativeConfirmed.title: Nativeconfirmed

ApprovalSummary.title: ApprovalSummary

BudgetLimitsInput.description: External nested budget input: camelCase aliases only (matches exported schema).
BudgetLimitsInput.title: BudgetLimitsInput

CandidateSnapshotRef.description: Locks a specific frozen snapshot — integrate must not follow 'latest'.
CandidateSnapshotRef.title: CandidateSnapshotRef

force.description: Still refuses if active refs/processes; never deletes user source root
force.title: Force

CollaborationMessage.description: Immutable message content and version refs — not delivery progress.
CollaborationMessage.title: CollaborationMessage

ConfirmationRequest.description: Exact confirmation scope awaiting a user decision.
ConfirmationRequest.title: ConfirmationRequest

CurrentExecutionRef.description: What the instance is bound to right now — not lifecycle and not idle/busy.
CurrentExecutionRef.title: CurrentExecutionRef

note.default: Discovery is not schedulability; accessLevel requires capability evidence
note.title: Note

ExecutionRequest.description:
Idempotent request to prepare confirmed role instances. Does not approve a plan.

Binding must include planHash + planVersion + assignmentVersion + gatePolicyVersion.
Does not start arbitrary stage tasks; D10 release still required for later stages.
ExecutionRequest.title: ExecutionRequest

GateDecision.description: Immutable StageController decision; not writable by review agents or clients.
GateDecision.title: GateDecision

GitStopEvidence.description: Trusted stop proof for workspace freeze — not a generic Runner terminal status.

evidencePath.description: Legacy display field; trust is established by the Runner ledger, never this file
evidencePath.title: Evidencepath

writesQuiesced.description: Must be true: no child/writable execution remains for the scope
writesQuiesced.title: Writesquiesced

GitStopEvidence.title: GitStopEvidence

candidateSnapshots.description: Ordered locked snapshots; merge uses these ids only
candidateSnapshots.title: Candidatesnapshots

mergeOrder.description: Optional workspace id order; must match candidateSnapshots set
mergeOrder.title: Mergeorder

MessageDelivery.description: Per-recipient delivery progress — transmission and reply are separate.
MessageDelivery.title: MessageDelivery

NativeApprovalRecordRequest.description: Inbound native approval request (adapter/host → platform ledger).

actionDigest.description: Optional client digest; server recomputes ActionDescriptor and rejects mismatches.
actionDigest.title: Actiondigest

NativeApprovalRecordRequest.title: NativeApprovalRecordRequest

PlanDecisionRequest.description: Confirm or reject a concrete confirmation request binding.
PlanDecisionRequest.title: PlanDecisionRequest

PlanProposalRequest.description: Request a read-only plan proposal. Does not start development.
PlanProposalRequest.title: PlanProposalRequest

PlanResourceEstimate.description: Estimate only — does not reserve execution budget.
PlanResourceEstimate.title: PlanResourceEstimate

PlanResponse.description: Current plan view for a run (definition + compile + assignment + confirm).
PlanResponse.title: PlanResponse

PlanRevisionRequest.description: Full-replacement revision of the current plan → new planVersion.
PlanRevisionRequest.title: PlanRevisionRequest

PlanSpec.description: Immutable complete plan definition for one planVersion.
PlanSpec.title: PlanSpec

PlanStageDefinition.description: Stage definition inside a plan — distinct from execution Stage instances (D09+).
PlanStageDefinition.title: PlanStageDefinition

PlanWorkPackageSpec.description: Plan-time work package definition (no runtime repair/status fields).

sharedWriteCoordination.description: Required when write scopes overlap with another package.
sharedWriteCoordination.title: Sharedwritecoordination

PlanWorkPackageSpec.title: PlanWorkPackageSpec

note.default: Product capability ≠ role readiness; approvalRoundtrip stays unsupported until product ack is evidenced
note.title: Note

ProjectCreateRequest.description: Consumes a valid DirectoryGrant — does not mint grants from client paths.
ProjectCreateRequest.title: ProjectCreateRequest

ProviderCredentialRegisterRequest.description: Registers a model credential secret; response never echoes the secret.
ProviderCredentialRegisterRequest.title: ProviderCredentialRegisterRequest

stageReleased.description: Always false until D10; published does not imply stage release.
stageReleased.title: Stagereleased

ReviewCycle.description: One audit cycle bound to a fixed candidate set fingerprint.
ReviewCycle.title: ReviewCycle

ReworkOrder.description: Targeted rework ticket — one valid order per problem set in a cycle.
ReworkOrder.title: ReworkOrder

RoutingDecision.description: Suggestion only. Never authorizes execution by itself.
RoutingDecision.title: RoutingDecision

RunCreateRequest.description:
Create a goal and enter preflight/planning. Does not dispatch development.

``mode=auto`` means the platform may auto-propose a plan; it does **not** mean
the platform may confirm assignments or start executors without user decisions.
``planningProviderProfileId`` configures the platform planning model only;
omit it for rules-only planning (do not invent a fake profile).

baselineId.description: Optional pin of the authorized baseline used for this run.
baselineId.title: Baselineid

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key for create; same key returns the same run.
idempotencyKey.title: Idempotencykey

RunCreateRequest.title: RunCreateRequest

requireEffectiveApproval.description: When true, execute requires a native-effective D04 grant.
requireEffectiveApproval.title: Requireeffectiveapproval

workspaceRoot.description: Platform-resolved workspace absolute path; runner re-validates confinement.
workspaceRoot.title: Workspaceroot

force.description: When true, stop the platform API even if agent drain coordination is incomplete. Default false: incomplete/unknown coordination returns 409 and does not exit.
force.title: Force

platformOnly.description: Dev/API-only stop: skip agent coordination when no collaboration DB is configured. Ignored when collaboration tables exist and report pending work unless force=true.
platformOnly.title: Platformonly

Stage.description: Runtime stage instance. Plan-time definitions live in PlanStageDefinition.
Stage.title: Stage

StageReleasePayload.description: Platform-derived only — not accepted on MessageCreateRequest.
StageReleasePayload.title: StageReleasePayload

StageSubmissionRequest.description: Client submission intent. Cannot declare stopped/verified/released.
StageSubmissionRequest.title: StageSubmissionRequest

StopEvidenceClaim.description: The same ledger-backed stop proof is required for D06 and D07.

evidencePath.description: Legacy display field; trust is established by the Runner ledger, never this file
evidencePath.title: Evidencepath

writesQuiesced.description: Must be true: no child/writable execution remains for the scope
writesQuiesced.title: Writesquiesced

StopEvidenceClaim.title: StopEvidenceClaim

TrustPolicy.description: Server-defined typed trust rules — callers cannot invent privilege escalations.
TrustPolicy.title: TrustPolicy

note.default: Recoverable via D06 store; audit must not use mutable worktree
note.title: Note

schema.title: Response Get Instance Api V1 Agent Instances  Instance Id  Get

get.description: Viewable bytes — does not authorize downstream consumption.

post.description:
Drain admission, verify agent stop coordination, then exit the API process.

Incomplete/unknown agent coordination returns 409 and does **not** invoke the
exit callback unless ``force`` is true. ``platformOnly`` allows API-only stop
when the database is unconfigured (pure dev); it cannot skip pending agents.

schema.title: Response Agent Message Api V1 Internal Agent Messages Post

post.description: Separate internal auth entry — users cannot self-set authentic/stopped.
